nodes.name: Art Historical Methodology
nodes.description: The methods and theories used to study, attribute, and interpret works of art.

nodes.name: Iconography
nodes.description: The study of the subject matter and symbolic meaning of images.

nodes.name: Connoisseurship
nodes.description: The practice of attributing artworks through trained judgment of style and quality.

nodes.name: History of Painting
nodes.description: The study of painting's development across cultures and periods.

nodes.name: History of Sculpture
nodes.description: The study of sculpture's development across cultures and periods.

nodes.name: History of Architecture
nodes.description: The study of architecture's stylistic and cultural development.

nodes.name: History of Printmaking
nodes.description: The study of prints and printmaking techniques across history.

nodes.name: History of Photography
nodes.description: The study of photography as an art and its historical development.

nodes.name: History of Decorative Arts
nodes.description: The study of ornamental and functional arts such as ceramics and textiles.

nodes.name: Western Art History
nodes.description: The history of art in Europe and its successor traditions.

nodes.name: Chinese Art History
nodes.description: The history of the visual arts of China.

nodes.name: Japanese Art History
nodes.description: The history of the visual arts of Japan.

nodes.name: Indian Art History
nodes.description: The history of the visual arts of the Indian subcontinent.

nodes.name: Islamic Art History
nodes.description: The history of art in the Islamic world.

nodes.name: African Art History
nodes.description: The history of the visual arts of Africa.

nodes.name: Pre-Columbian Art History
nodes.description: The history of the arts of the Americas before European contact.

nodes.name: Oceanic Art History
nodes.description: The history of the arts of the Pacific Islands.

nodes.name: Formal Analysis
nodes.description: The analysis of artworks through line, color, composition, and form.

nodes.name: Provenance Research
nodes.description: The tracing of an artwork's ownership history and authenticity.

nodes.name: Art Historiography
nodes.description: The study of how the history of art has itself been written.

nodes.name: Prehistoric Art
nodes.description: The cave paintings and portable art of Paleolithic and Neolithic peoples.

nodes.name: Egyptian Art
nodes.description: The canonical art of pharaonic Egypt, from reliefs to tomb painting.

nodes.name: Classical Art
nodes.description: The art of ancient Greece and Rome, from the Archaic to late antiquity.

nodes.name: Byzantine Art
nodes.description: The art of the Eastern Roman Empire, especially its icons and mosaics.

nodes.name: Medieval Art
nodes.description: The art of the European Middle Ages, from early Christian to Gothic.

nodes.name: Renaissance Art
nodes.description: The fifteenth- and sixteenth-century revival of classical ideals in European art.

nodes.name: Baroque Art
nodes.description: The seventeenth-century art of drama, movement, and emotional intensity.

nodes.name: Rococo
nodes.description: The eighteenth-century art of ornament, lightness, and aristocratic elegance.

nodes.name: Neoclassicism
nodes.description: The late eighteenth-century return to classical restraint and civic virtue.

nodes.name: Romanticism
nodes.description: The early nineteenth-century movement emphasizing emotion, nature, and the sublime.

nodes.name: Realism
nodes.description: The mid-nineteenth-century movement depicting everyday life without idealization.

nodes.name: Impressionism
nodes.description: The late nineteenth-century movement capturing light and momentary perception.

nodes.name: Post-Impressionism
nodes.description: The movement that extended Impressionism toward more expressive and structured form.

nodes.name: Modern Art
nodes.description: The avant-garde movements of the early twentieth century that broke with tradition.

nodes.name: Contemporary Art
nodes.description: Art produced from the late twentieth century to the present.

nodes.name: Romanesque Art
nodes.description: The European art of the eleventh and twelfth centuries of massive solid forms.

nodes.name: Gothic Art
nodes.description: The late medieval art of pointed arches, light, and naturalism.

nodes.name: Fauvism
nodes.description: The early modern movement of vivid, non-naturalistic color.

nodes.name: Cubism
nodes.description: The movement that fragmented form into geometric planes and multiple viewpoints.

nodes.name: Expressionism
nodes.description: The movement that privileged emotional intensity over objective representation.

nodes.name: Surrealism
nodes.description: The movement drawing on dreams and the unconscious to subvert reality.

nodes.name: Dada
nodes.description: The anti-art movement that rejected rational aesthetics after World War I.

nodes.name: Abstract Expressionism
nodes.description: The post-war American movement of gestural abstraction.

nodes.name: Chinese Painting
nodes.description: The brush-and-ink painting tradition of China.

nodes.name: Chinese Calligraphy
nodes.description: The art of writing Chinese characters with brush and ink.

nodes.name: Chinese Ceramics
nodes.description: The porcelain and pottery tradition of China.

nodes.name: Chinese Sculpture
nodes.description: The sculptural tradition of China, including Buddhist cave carvings.

nodes.name: Shanshui Painting
nodes.description: The Chinese landscape painting genre depicting mountains and water.

nodes.name: Gongbi Painting
nodes.description: The meticulous Chinese painting technique of fine outline and detail.

nodes.name: Ukiyo-e
nodes.description: The Japanese woodblock print and painting tradition of the floating world.

nodes.name: Yamato-e
nodes.description: The native Japanese painting style depicting courtly and narrative subjects.

nodes.name: Nihonga
nodes.description: The modern Japanese painting movement reviving traditional materials and themes.

nodes.name: Japanese Ceramics
nodes.description: The ceramic arts of Japan, including tea ceremony wares.

nodes.name: Indian Sculpture
nodes.description: The sculptural tradition of India, from Mauryan to Chola bronzes.

nodes.name: Gandhara Art
nodes.description: The Greco-Buddhist art of ancient Gandhara.

nodes.name: Mughal Miniature Painting
nodes.description: The courtly miniature painting of the Mughal empire.

nodes.name: Islamic Calligraphy
nodes.description: The art of beautiful writing central to Islamic visual culture.

nodes.name: Islamic Architecture
nodes.description: The architectural tradition of the Islamic world, from mosques to palaces.

nodes.name: Islamic Miniature Painting
nodes.description: The illuminated manuscript painting of the Persian and Ottoman courts.

nodes.name: African Sculpture
nodes.description: The mask and figure sculpture traditions of Africa.

nodes.name: African Textile Art
nodes.description: The textile traditions of Africa, including kente and adinkra.

nodes.name: Maya Art
nodes.description: The sculpture, painting, and architecture of the ancient Maya.

nodes.name: Aztec Art
nodes.description: The monumental and ritual art of the Aztec empire.

nodes.name: Andean Art
nodes.description: The art of the Andean civilizations, including the Inca.
